faq.moreDescription: The easiest way is to watch your own map fill up.

what.question: What is Kilotrace?
what.answer: Kilotrace turns your sports activities into a map to complete. Each track colors the tiles it crosses, advances your countries, unlocks stations and badges. A good reason to leave the beaten path.

tiles.question: What is a tile?
tiles.answer: The map is cut into regular squares. Large tiles are about 1.7 km on a side in France, small ones about 200 m. A tile is visited as soon as one of your tracks crosses it.

square.question: What is the biggest square?
square.answer: It's the largest square block of tiles that are all visited. It rewards methodical exploration: to grow it, you have to go and find the tiles missing on its edges.

sources.question: How are my activities imported?
sources.answer: You connect the account of a compatible service, such as Strava. Your history is imported, then your new outings arrive automatically. You can revoke access at any time: imported activities are then deleted.

sports.question: Which activities are counted?
sports.answer: All those with a GPS track: running, cycling, hiking, walking, trail running, cross-country skiing and many more. Indoor activities, without a track, don't color the map.

privacy.question: Is my profile public?
privacy.answer: No. Your profile is private by default: people who want to follow you send a request, which you accept or not.

mobile.question: Can I use Kilotrace on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. Kilotrace works in the browser, on computer or phone, with no app to install.

account.question: How do I create an account?
account.answer: With your email address or your Google account, in under a minute. Then you connect your activities to watch your map fill up.
